info.name: API GoLogin
info.description:
About GoLogin API

You can connect to the GoLogin API to integrate it with other programs, enabling process automation using custom scripts and bots.

Note: Using the API requires programming skills.

Supported GoLogin API Packages

Node.js (Supports Puppeteer)

  • NPM Package: GoLogin on npm

  • Repository: GitHub - gologinapp/gologin

  • Documentation: Gologin Docs

Python (Supports Pyppeteer and Selenium)

  • Pip Package: GoLogin on pip

  • Repository: GitHub - gologinapp/pygologin

Rate Limits

Plan Requests per minute
Free & Trial 300
Paid 1200

Quickstart Guide

1. Authentication

Get your API token:

  1. Open the GoLogin web or desktop app

  2. Settings → API Documentation

  3. Click New Token to generate your API token.

2. Create a Browser

Use the Create Quick Browser request to create a reliable browser.

2.1 Update Created Browser (Optional)

Use the Update Browser request to update browser parameters in case you need to change them.

3. Set a Proxy

Set a proxy to your browser using the Set browser proxy request.

4. Run the Browser

Python Example

  1. Download the example script

  2. pip3 install gologin selenium

  3. Run the script with your Browser ID and API token.

JavaScript Example

  1. Download the example script

  2. npm install gologin

  3. Run the script with your Browser ID and API token.

If no Browser ID is provided, a new browser is created automatically.

Need help?

Reach out to the support team at https://gologin.com/contact

response.name: Retrieve browser

request.description:
This section outlines how to create a browser using the API, including required and optional parameters for optimal reliability and uniqueness.

Important Notes

  • Required parameters are necessary to create a browser.

  • For maximum stability, leave optional parameters set to their default values, unless customization is needed.

  • Allowed values can be found in the request body.

Required Parameters

These parameters are mandatory for creating a valid browser browser.

Parameter Description
os Operating system

Optional Parameters

These parameters are optional and come with default values. Modify only if customization is needed.

Parameter Description
osSpec Specific OS/hardware version.
name Custom name for the browser.
proxy Proxy configuration for the browser.
navigator Navigator fingerprint settings.
fonts Font fingerprint settings.
webGLMetadata Metadata related to WebGL.
webglParams Specific WebGL parameters.
notes Additional notes related to the browser.
startUrl URL to open automatically on browser start.
googleServicesEnabled Enables or disables Google services.
lockEnabled Enables browser locking.
storage Storage settings (local/session).
dns Custom DNS server settings.
plugins Plugin fingerprint settings.
timezone Timezone settings.
audioContext AudioContext fingerprint settings.
canvas Canvas fingerprint settings.
mediaDevices Media device fingerprint configuration.
webRTC WebRTC fingerprint settings.
webGL WebGL fingerprint settings.
clientRects ClientRects fingerprint settings.
chromeExtensions List of Chrome extensions to load.

This section outlines how to create a quick browser using the API, including required and optional parameters for optimal reliability and uniqueness.

Created browser is reliable by default.

Required Parameters

These parameters are mandatory for creating a valid browser browser.

Parameter Description
os Operating system
name Browser name

Optional Parameters

Parameter Description
osSpec Specifies hardware/OS version
isM1 Indicates Apple Silicon (M1/M2/M3/M4) compatibility
folderName The actual folder name
resolution Resolution in x format
